title: Shaak Ti
franchise: Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith
description: Wise and patient, it was no wonder that Jedi Master Shaak Ti was assigned to supervise the training of clone cadets on Kamino after fighting in the first battle of Geonosis at the start of the Clone Wars. Shaak Ti fought to defend Kamino against Separatist attacks, doing her best to balance her duties on Kamino with her role on the Jedi Council.
